title: Cypremort Point State Park Improvements (TV-0081)
intro: A three-stop look at this CPRA project: where it is, what it changes, and its status and funding.

steps.title: Where it's at
steps.body: This project is at Cypremort Point State Park, about 1.5 miles northeast of Cypremort Point in Vermilion Bay, spanning St. Mary and Iberia Parishes.

media.alt: Aerial view of Cypremort Point and the surrounding marsh, Iberia/St. Mary Parishes (2024 aerial imagery).

steps.title: What it is changing
steps.body: Repeated flooding had damaged park roads and parking, and the rock jetty and public beach needed work. The project reinforced the Quintana Canal rock embankment, restored the public beach, built a new marsh boardwalk, repaired flood-damaged roads, and added an RV campground with up to 30 pull-through sites — expanding recreation and education opportunities for the community.

media.alt: The new marsh boardwalk at Cypremort Point State Park. Photo: Louisiana Office of Tourism, via iberiatravel.com (attribution/usage pending confirmation, same as this project's other pending-confirmation media).

steps.title: Timeline / Completion Date
steps.body: Project Status: Completed. Estimated Cost: $5,577,338, all state dollars. Funding Source: Natural Resource Damage Assessment (NRDA).
